comparison: Major jump from v1 (8/16) -> v2 (11/15) -> v3 (14/16, 0 timeouts), beating every alt-optimizer and SGD arm while cutting r256 idle latency 1.84x and VRAM -129.2 MiB.
conclusion: law4-energy-v3 jumped to 14/16 PASS (2 FAIL, 0 INCOMPLETE/TIMEOUT) on r4-occam-ablation-v1 with 0 Conv2d NS and 0 B/param non-stiff state: PASSED model_ddgan_gaussian_chain (eig_max=1.0859!), grid100 (prec=0.9919, ctr=0.1249 vs unified-v11 0.1379), img_bars4 (4/4, hq=1.0000 at 0 Conv2d NS), five_word_joint_smoke, gaussian1d_stability (ks=0.0265), zero_tanh_rail_escape, ring16 (0.9863), vector_unequal_mass (0.9980), both Nash >500x tasks (0.9587/0.9517), t3_iso_scale_mass_8x (eig=0.4683), and t3_iso_horizon_saddle_shift (0.9609). Only 2 misses remained: vector_unequal_width (hq=0.9795, eig=0.2697) and grid100_mlp16 (prec=0.9570, ctr=0.6775) — both caused solely by dropping opt_d's 2D-only critic secant guard (which already costs 0.00 ms on 4D Conv2d DCGANs).

hypothesis: law4-energy-v3 achieves 15/16-16/16 PASS on r4-occam-ablation-v1 (matching or exceeding unified-v11 on grid100, grid100_mlp16, model_ddgan_gaussian_chain, img_bars4, t3_iso_scale_mass_8x, zero_tanh_rail_escape, and Nash) while eliminating 4D Conv2d NS and critic secant probes.
next_action: Implement law4-energy-v4 restoring opt_d's 2D-only critic secant guard (0.00 ms on 4D images since _d_probe_list is empty for 4D inputs) to hit 16/16 on r4-occam-ablation-v1 and run full matched verification vs unified-v11.
